shared: All three link neighbouring units into one group, so what happens to one spreads to its neighbours.
differ: What spreads: chain-reaction triggers, stat gains that halve each step, or the damage from hits.

takes.label: The lit fuse
takes.line: Units store counters; at three, a unit fires its own text and passes counters on, so one spark sets off a chain.
takes.look_if: chain-reaction combos and a spend-or-hold choice each turn.

takes.label: Ripples that halve
takes.line: Buffs spread from one unit outward, halving each step, so you place where growth starts; a late card ends the halving.
takes.look_if: steady stat growth where each unit's spot sets its share.

takes.label: One body, shared wounds
takes.line: Every Rat, from Tier 1, shares each hit with its whole group, so fights change: damage triggers fire on every share.
takes.look_if: fights that play differently, with every Rat sharing the damage.
